epa_radon_zones.name: EPA Map of Radon Zones (county table, EPA 402-R-93-071; table updated 2025-09)
epa_radon_zones.licence: US public domain (EPA Standard Open Data License)
epa_radon_zones.method: matched by county name and state (the table has no FIPS); renamed or split units since 1993 take the zone of the unit they came from; Connecticut planning regions and Puerto Rico have no zone

usgs_nure_gamma.name: Bayesian modeling of NURE airborne radiometric data for the conterminous United States: predictions and grids (Goldman & Ellefsen 2020, doi:10.5066/P9YEAFHI)
usgs_nure_gamma.licence: US public domain (USGS data release, listed CC0 on data.usgs.gov)
usgs_nure_gamma.method: area mean of 2 km EPSG:5070 grid cells whose centres fall in the county (all touched cells if none); conterminous US only

epa_aqs_design_values.name: EPA Air Quality Design Values 2023-2025 (ozone Table 4, PM2.5 Tables 4a/4b county level), from AQS
epa_aqs_design_values.licence: US public domain (EPA Standard Open Data License)
epa_aqs_design_values.method: EPA's county design value (highest valid monitor in the county); Connecticut planning regions rebuilt from EPA's site tables by site location; ozone converted ppm to ppb
